about: Whether a feature is free for the caller. With NAME: `feature` is the name, `answer` is yours (the caller leads it), free (no lead) or free-stale (the lead's lease is stale: `lead` holds that lead), `warnings` are the feature's own warnings, the ones the text form prints on standard error as `qargi: warning: ...` (the lead is stale, the feature has no lead or was abandoned, another feature changes the same files), and `features` is absent. Other sentences on standard error (an anonymous lead identity, a remote that was not checked, a lease that was not renewed) are not in the document: `remote` says the second. Without NAME: `feature` and `answer` are null, `lead` is null, `warnings` is empty, and `features` holds one row for each open feature with its own `warnings`. A feature held by another live lead is not an answer: the verb exits 1 with a qargi-refusal line on standard error and no document, and a remote that cannot be asked (without --assume-unreachable-ok) exits 3 the same way. `remote` and `backend` are as in qargi-marshal-status: with --assume-unreachable-ok and a remote that cannot be reached the verb exits 0 from the cache and `remote` is unchecked; with --no-fetch or --no-write nothing is fetched and `remote` is not-asked on the shared refs backend. `lease` and `minutes_since_renewal` of a row mean what `lease_clock` says, as in qargi-marshal-status. `integrity` is the integrity setting of the project, off, advisory or strict: with off the records are unsigned by design and no row has the fields `integrity`, `integrity_note` and `signer`; with advisory or strict every row has them.
writes: Unless --no-write is given: on the local backend a record whose branch is gone is marked abandoned; on the shared refs backend the call fetches the shared records into this machine's cache and updates this machine's own observation cache, with --no-fetch too (a lock file with it) and, with integrity on, its acceptance marks; with --assume-unreachable-ok it appends one audit line. With --no-write nothing is written and nothing is fetched. The shared records are never changed.

integrity.description: The integrity setting of the project (qargi marshal enable --integrity): off, so the records are unsigned by design and a row has no `integrity`, `integrity_note` or `signer`; advisory or strict, so a row says whether its record is signed and by whom (a row of an unsigned record says so). Read it before you read a signature field that is missing.

backend.description: Where the records live: this host's files or the shared refs of the project's remote.

remote.description: Whether the answer was checked against the remote of the shared records: none, checked, unchecked (the fetch failed, with --assume-unreachable-ok) or not-asked (--no-fetch, --no-write or a member run).

feature.description: The feature asked about; null when no NAME was given.

answer.description: null when no NAME was given.

lead.description: The stale lead when the answer is free-stale; null otherwise.

warnings.description: The warnings of the feature asked about (only its own, not every sentence the verb prints on standard error); empty when no NAME was given (each row of `features` has its own).

features.x-when: No NAME was given: one row for each open feature.

worktree.x-when: The lead record names its work tree (a digest of its path).

succeeds.x-when: The lead took over as the successor of an earlier lead of the same host, user and work tree.

status.description: unled: the feature has a branch and no record.

lease.description: none: the feature has no lead.

minutes_since_renewal.description: Whole minutes; null when the feature has no lead or the age is unknown.

renewed_at.description: The time of the last renewal as the record holds it; null when it was never renewed.

branch.description: The branch feature/NAME exists in this repository.

ghost.description: The record is abandoned and its branch is gone.

warnings.description: The warnings of this feature, the ones the text form prints for it as `qargi: warning: ...` on standard error.

provisional.x-when: Shared refs backend: true while a claim has not reached the remote.

integrity.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off.

integrity_note.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off.

signer.x-when: The project's integrity setting is not off; empty when the record is not signed.

history.change: the top-level `integrity` (off, advisory or strict) is required: it says whether an unsigned record is unsigned by design
